snippet.title: Only One AirPod Working? Here's How to Fix!
snippet.description:

snippet.title: iOS 8/OS X Yosemite Family Sharing Overview
snippet.description:
With iOS 8 and OS X Yosemite, Apple introduced Family Sharing, a handy feature designed to let family members share App Store purchases, iTunes music, and books. 

Family Sharing also includes a unified photo album and calendar for family members, along with location sharing tools, a shared Find My iPhone feature, and parental controls that let adults oversee their children's app purchases.

snippet.title: How to Set Up and Use Handoff in iOS 8 and OS X Yosemite
snippet.description:
Handoff is one of the new Continuity features introduced in iOS 8 and OS X Yosemite, letting users begin a task on one device and seamlessly pick it up on another. 

Handoff is available on several built-in Apple apps like Mail, Safari, and iWork, and it also works with third-party apps that have added support for the feature, including Pixelmator, Wunderlist, and more.

For more information on Handoff, how to set it up, and how to get it working if you're having problems, make sure to check out our Handoff how to: http://www.macrumors.com/2014/10/24/how-to-handoff-not-working/

snippet.title: OS X Yosemite Overview
snippet.description:
OS X Yosemite, Apple's newest Mac operating system, introduces a flatter, more modern iOS 7-style look that emphasizes translucency, streamlined toolbars, and smarter controls. 

Along with a new look, OS X Yosemite includes several feature improvements, like a "Today" view in Notification Center that offers integration with third-party apps and an improved Spotlight search that pulls in data from new sources. 

Apple has also added improvements to several core apps, bringing a new look to Safari and new features to the Mail app, like Mail Drop, for attachments up to 5GB and Markup, which lets users make annotations to images and documents from within the Mail app. 

Yosemite's most notable feature set is "Continuity," which allows the new OS to integrate deeply with iOS 8. With Handoff, users can start a task on one device and complete it on another with a seamless transition, and another Continuity feature, SMS relay, will let users answer phone calls on their Macs. 

Yosemite is available as a free download to all Mac users beginning on October 16. For more information on the new operating system, make sure to check out our OS X Yosemite Roundup: 

http://www.macrumors.com/roundup/os-x/

snippet.title: iOS 8 Emergency Medical ID Overview
snippet.description:
Apple's new Health app, introduced with iOS 8, includes a built-in Medical ID feature, which allows an iPhone user's health information to be displayed on the lock screen in case of an emergency. 

The Medical ID includes information like birth date, allergies, specific medical conditions, blood type, and emergency contact information. 

Looking for more info on iOS 8? Check out our dedicated iOS 8 roundup. 

http://www.macrumors.com/roundup/ios-8/

snippet.title: iPhone 6 and 6 Plus Reachability Overview
snippet.description:
With the release of the large-screened iPhone 6 and iPhone 6 Plus, Apple introduced Reachability to make it easier to use the devices one-handed. A quick double tap (not a press) on the home button will slide all content on the iPhone's display down towards the bottom of the screen, where it can be accessed with one hand.

Get more info on the iPhone 6 and iPhone 6 Plus in our official roundup: http://www.macrumors.com/roundup/iphone-6/
